ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis Federal Shooting
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of a 37-year-old man by federal agents in Minneapolis.
ideas.angle: Examining the facts surrounding the shooting and potential patterns of excessive force by federal agents.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
Was the use of force justified?
ideas.insight: This story has significant implications for federal law enforcement accountability and potential patterns of excessive force.

ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate allegations of potential fraud at a former Minnesota factory housing 400 Medicaid businesses.
ideas.angle: Examining the facts surrounding the allegations of Medicaid fraud and potential misuse of funds.
questions: What are the details of the allegations?
What is the extent of the potential fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has significant implications for Medicaid program integrity and potential misuse of funds.
